item.title: Now Accepting Applications: Smart Medicine and Health Informatics Master's Program
item.description: The Smart Medicine and Health Informatics Master’s Program at National Taiwan University is now accepting applications. This international program offers advanced studies in bioinformatics, computational medicine, and precision health. We welcome motivated students from diverse backgrounds to join our lab and contribute to cutting-edge research at the intersection of AI and medicine.
